instruction: cart.py has state-sharing bugs. (1) Two `Cart()` instances created without arguments share the same underlying line list. (2) `Cart(lines)` keeps a reference to the caller's list, so later changes to the cart leak into it (and vice versa). (3) `Cart.copy()` returns a cart whose line dicts are the same objects as the original's, so changing a quantity in the copy changes the original. (4) `merge(a, b)` mutates `a`. Fix all of these so carts never share mutable state with each other or with caller-provided data, while keeping the public API (`Cart`, `add`, `set_quantity`, `total_cents`, `copy`, `lines`, `merge`) and its return values unchanged. All tests in tests/test_cart.py must pass.
